adapter_owner: Management owns StatsCampaignAdapter; active statistics annex contains no collection adapter. Only the sibling interface was inspected.
scope: G7-G10; all collection/provenance verification is injected and independently rederived by collection code

protocol.root: path to campaign/output root; writes root/statistics/{analysis,power,calibration}. Power forbids actual units/outcome, units/endpoint, units/outcome-anchors and contacts/outcome plus historical paths; directory absence alone is insufficient.
protocol.repo: path to pinned repository, for receipt provenance only; statistics never imports predecessor analyzers
protocol.entryexit(stage): UNENTERED context manager; statistics creates its exclusive CLAIM first. Validates independently committed complete source/import/read pins at ENTRY AND EXIT, re-enumerates inventories, consumes separately evidenced stage authority, checks all global HALTED markers; raises on failure. Yields {provenance_sha256:SHA256,input_sha256:{logical_name:SHA256},...stage-specific fields below}. No pass boolean. Source closure includes all exp7stats/exp7core modules and package initializers, aliases and transitive executed imports, not just a snapshot.
protocol.battery(): returns battery payload below; immutable by convention, statistics copies to immutable dataclasses and rechecks full coverage
protocol.predictor_data(): returns {schema:'exp7.analysis-predictors.v1',trained:{pythia_1b:{family:[{id,draws:{q0:[str*64],q1:[str*64],q0s:[str*64],q1s:[str*64]}}]},olmo2_1b:{...}},twin:{family:[{id,draws:{four arms each16 strings}}]}}; lists in battery order
protocol.verify_predictor_seal(): rederives complete trained+twin+anchor source/provenance/coverage gates; returns {seal_sha256:SHA256,battery_sha256:SHA256,bindings:{relative_path:SHA256}}; nonempty bindings, no self-pins
protocol.verify_power(): rederives separately committed pre-outcome power record and bindings; returns {power_sha256:SHA256,record:<decoded root/statistics/power/power.json>}. Its semantic validator MUST independently rescore sealed predictor raw draws and derive geometry; see saved_power_validation. Statistics also independently derives geometry after loading raw predictors. No simulation/RNG replay.
protocol.verify_complete(): analysis only: rederives complete26 outcome windows, full paired endpoint gates per host, all raw/provenance/anchor/seal/timing constraints; returns {complete_sha256:SHA256,bindings:{relative_path:SHA256}}

battery_payload.levels_sha256: actual tagged base-strata level table SHA256

each_family: all21 certified baseline responder IDs, including N/A cells

each_family.base: stable tagged merged base-stratum ID; metadata-only, no model values

each_certified_baseline_ID.na_reason: null for applicable; nonempty certified reason for N/A
each_certified_baseline_ID.outputs: applicable: exact four-arm string dict; N/A:null
each_certified_baseline_ID.abstained: applicable: exact four-arm bool dict; N/A:null

serialization: statistics internal Fraction values serialize as {numerator:int,denominator:positive_int}; serializer recursively restores these on read; all other fields ordinary JSON; no NaN/Infinity

stage_requirements.calibration: BEFORE prereg tag, projection and predictor seal. Pure CalibrationContext(root,repo,candidate_commit=40hex,manifest_path=repo_relative,manifest_sha256=independently_fixed_SHA). Bind committed candidate code/design/synthetic-case manifest AND exactly one runtime_spec, described below; no Campaign constructor, model backend or model-contact grant. Candidate/external pins and Python execution checks cover aliases/generated/precompiled calls. The interface-v4 cold_read_boundary below governs input consumption: inherited readable OS descriptors/file buffers refuse; pinned read-only path opens return verified snapshots, never input fds. Output root outside candidate repo. No preregistration tag may exist. Yields synthetic_spec matching calibration.frozen_cases() and candidate_commit. Serial operation may not spawn threads/processes. This planning stage does not execute production calibration.
stage_requirements.power: AFTER verified predictor seal and accepted committed calibration, BEFORE ANY outcome contact/probe/load/grant/phase marker. Context requires independently evidenced power authority, prereg/projection pins, verified seal and complete no-outcome contact inventory at entry AND exit. input_sha256 must include code_manifest,source_manifest,calibration,contact_inventory, plus every read/source binding. calibration is hash of root/statistics/calibration/calibration.json; adapter may copy byte-identical accepted pre-tag calibration into that immutable path before power. Power never reads outcomes() or computes actual selectivity p/effect gate.
stage_requirements.analysis: Requires prereg/projection, predictor seal, independently committed complete outcome receipt and pre-outcome power record, all data/host/anchor gates and owner's once-only analyzer word/grant. Context verifies at entry AND exit; actual raw draws are returned only inside context. Statistics consumes exclusive claim before any data reads. No automatic rerun on refusal.

contact_inventory.contract: The yielded contact_inventory contains ONLY schema,covered_roots,entries. Bind its canonical exp7stats.common.dumps SHA as input_sha256.contact_inventory. Adapter inventories ALL actual collection contact/load/claim/grant/probe/phase roots, not just these minimum prefixes; must refuse unrecognized/unclassifiable markers, every outcome-related marker (including unconsumed outcome grant), and any omitted receipt. Exit re-enumerates and compares to ENTRY inventory, not just rehashing the old dict. A claimed empty inventory is not verification. stats rechecks the binding/path absence before final publish.

baseline_rules.catalog: Exactly21 distinct certified responder IDs in EACH of the four families, plus aggregate49 applicable/35 N/A. A coherent20/21/21/22 catalog refuses with baseline_missing coverage diagnostics.
baseline_rules.missing: Any omitted catalog cell/row/arm or unknown applicability refuses; refusal report names baseline coverage/applicability failure. No missing cell may masquerade as N/A.
baseline_rules.not_applicable: All35 cells retained with certified nonempty reason; output/abstention fields null, no invented raw strings.
baseline_rules.applicable: All49 cells retained. Adapter may map archived deterministic baseline None to empty-string MISS ONLY with abstained[arm]=true and preserved per-pair metadata; non-None raw strings remain unchanged. N/A status/reason fixed across500 pairs in a cell. Never remove applicable abstentions from 49-cell denominator.
baseline_rules.model_outputs: Predictor/twin/outcome raw None ALWAYS refuses, never converts to string or MISS.
baseline_rules.report: S7 includes all84 cells, applicability denominator49, N/A reasons, abstentions by arm and pair, N500 for every applicable cell; S8 rescoring applies to every applicable raw baseline.

collection_mapping.battery: Use certified Battery, base_assignments(), baseline_catalog(), baseline_draws(); preserve exact certified identity/metadata, words->unscrambling already collection-owned. Do not reverse-engineer raw from Score.
collection_mapping.predictors: Use predictor_draws() axes pair/ARMS/draw; predictor_data() scores are only cross-checks; stats rederives from raw.
collection_mapping.outcomes: Use outcome_draws() axes pair/GRID/ARMS; stats rederives all counts. Collection outcomes() alone cannot satisfy raw contract.
collection_mapping.receipts: Use seal_bindings(), power_bindings(), complete_bindings(). verify_complete() returning None is not itself a receipt. Independent committed receipt identity must be preserved.
collection_mapping.source_bindings: input_sha256 keys code_manifest and source_manifest must map actual independently pinned collection manifest values (bindings() publishes names with _sha256 suffix). No made-up expected hashes.
collection_mapping.power_validator: Decode via exp7stats.common.decode, independently load/re-score raw sealed predictors with exp7stats.data.load_predictors, derive geometry=exp7stats.power.predictor_geometry(predictors), then exp7stats.power.verify_power_semantics(record,sealSHA,batterySHA,geometry=geometry). Mandatory independent geometry; omitted geometry or v1 saved trace format refuses. Collection wrapper may discard verified return and return None only at its own API; statistics adapter still returns independent receipt+record. Never derive geometry from record.predictor_support or record-provided outcomes.

production_api: python -B -m exp7stats.calibration_cli --root OUTPUT --repo REPO --candidate-commit COMMIT --manifest PATH --manifest-sha256 SHA
candidate_manifest: schema exp7.calibration-candidate.v1, files:{repo_relative_path:{kind:source|design|synthetic_spec|runtime_spec,sha256:SHA}}; exactly one synthetic_spec AND one runtime_spec. Include every .py in both pure packages, local helpers/init/CLI modules, design and frozen case JSON. Manifest and files must match independently fixed committed candidate. Clear candidate bytecode before cold launch. Existing cache reads refuse; a genuinely absent cache probe for pinned source is force-failed with ENOENT, preventing a successful raced unbound read. The required runtime_spec extension is interface-v3; old candidate manifests refuse.

calibration_runtime_manifest.authority: Roots label explicitly allowed installed runtimes; they are NOT wildcard permissions. Every loaded file, external helper/read and native extension is exactly pinned. Ordinary Python code must match compilation of pinned source; generated exec/calls must match committed code fingerprints and pinned producers. Bind all cold launcher and transitive helpers. Provision/review host-specific manifest before execution; tests/runtime_fixture.allowance is fabricated test authority and MUST NOT become a production discovery-and-trust path.

cold_read_boundary.entry_exit: SystemReadPort checks the complete Darwin /dev/fd or Linux /proc/self/fd census with F_GETFL, refuses every inherited readable descriptor (even pinned, fd0 or an alias), and separately refuses OS-backed readable IOBase buffers. Only EBADF for an already-closed enumeration entry is ignored; other observation failures refuse. Existing Python workers refuse. No descriptor is auto-enrolled by name or bytes. Write-only output descriptors are retained.
cold_read_boundary.read_api: During calibration use builtins.open, io.open, pathlib reads or io/_io.open_code on independently pinned read-only paths. The controlled wrapper runs the existing path/cache check, then obtains all bytes from an actual regular-file fd, verifies fstat/stat identity on both sides, size and independent SHA, closes the fd, and returns a read-only memory snapshot. Buffered/text layers and iteration consume only that snapshot; fileno is unsupported. Existing absent-cache ENOENT/race rules remain exact.
cold_read_boundary.refused_api: Inherited file streams/descriptors (including pinned ones), readable os.open, prebound original open aliases, direct FileIO constructors, update/read-write modes, custom openers and file mappings refuse. Close inherited inputs and reopen pinned paths inside the context. Output open/write remains ordinary write-only I/O. Publication/fsync remains outside the read context as before.
cold_read_boundary.launch: The dedicated cold CLI closes both its own stdin wrapper and kernel fd0, including interpreter closefd=False. Other callers must enter with no inherited readable fds/buffers and write-only stdout/stderr. No stdin allowance or broad runtime exemption exists.
cold_read_boundary.platform_and_test_port: CalibrationContext adds read_port=None; None selects the complete SystemReadPort implementation. Explicit injected ports are synthetic-only test seams, like fake blob/tag readers; never use a discovery-and-trust or claimed-empty observation in production. New read_boundary.py, gc/fcntl/runtime dependencies and caller code must be independently bound. Runtime manifest schema stays exp7.calibration-runtime.v1; no new authority keys.
cold_read_boundary.guarantee_limit: This is the controlled CPython file-I/O contract of the reviewed serial calibration source, not an OS sandbox. The cold census + snapshot/no-exposed-input-fd invariant covers descriptor aliases without claiming c_call can reveal os.read arguments. Byte-pinned native runtime is still trusted: arbitrary direct native syscalls, deliberate mutation of guard internals, and provenance of preloaded non-stream Python values are not traced. Alternate native filesystem APIs are outside the permitted candidate call graph, not a new trusted input channel. Direct fromfile and file mmap entrypoints refuse, but that is not claimed as mediation of every possible native alias.

saved_power_validation.geometry: exp7.predictor-geometry.v1: predictor/family exact x and serialized stratum vectors plus independently rederived support. Obtain only through predictor_geometry(load_predictors(verified raw payload,battery)); record stores geometry_sha256, not authority for its expected geometry.
saved_power_validation.retained_inputs: Each fit evaluation has phase/rho/outcomes/D summary; all prescribed endpoint/interior/final/validation evaluations retained. Each outcome family stores zlib-compressed hex uint8 count matrix, replicate-major and battery-pair order. Main stores main_outcomes and finite-MC n_ge/consumed/B bounds. Exact dimensions/count multiset and domains are checked before use.
saved_power_validation.derived: Per-family numerator/denominator, exact subset/None consistency, all Ds/means/scatter, eligibility and uninformative-block frequencies, rho1 rank-order condition, deterministic fixed-margin extrema, complete bisection path and support status, full/p-only counts/rates/CP95 intervals, total permutations and all10 declarations. Constant and blockwise-constant x remain and cannot acquire positive D or impossible rejection counts.
saved_power_validation.authenticated_inputs_not_rng_replay: Saved outcome count matrices and MC exceedance counts require independent source/receipt authentication. Semantic checks do not reconstruct Gaussian/tie banks, independent-stream history, rank/noise law for interior rho, actual sampled permutation identities or their exceedance sequence. They derive finite-p arithmetic and deterministic impossibility constraints; they are not a proof that arbitrary coherent invented traces came from the committed RNG. No selectivity p is calculated on sealed predictors during power.

saved_envelope_validation: saved_math_version2 calibration retains score_counts: one packed uint8 matrix per replicate, family/pair order with canonical n00,n01,n10,n11 then sham four counts; randomization_bounds retain n_ge/consumed/B. Validator rederives valid prompt probability rows, analytic expected_x, every x/d/u/support/histogram/count/rate/CP95 reading including p-only CI, and exact structural-zero/impossible rows. No RNG replay; exceedance counts remain independently authenticated inputs with finite-bound and deterministic-support checks.
